answer: Every new identity starts on a narrow ledge: a 400 POA escrow deposit and its referrer's name on a public graph. At the dawn of each epoch any peer may dispute a farmed identity; a jury of eight checks it, and a confirmed fake loses its deposit while the challenger keeps 100. Forging 1,000 identities costs 400,000 POA. Honest agents pay once and earn it back through attested work; a pulse check each epoch confirms their graph is clean.
